## Outcome

Describe the learner or defender workflow that changed. Link the supporting issue if applicable.

## Evidence

List the checks you executed and their observed results. For detections, include the source, affected fixtures, suppression behavior and validation status.

## Review

- [ ] Examples use generated records and reviewed sources.
- [ ] Changed fields, limitations and expected behavior are documented.
- [ ] Screenshots and exports came from an actual run and contain only shareable sample data.
